entities.summary: Robert Poulet was a Belgian writer, literary critic and journalist. Politically he was a Maurras-inspired integral nationalist who became associated with a collaborationist newspaper during the occupation of Belgium by Nazi Germany. Robert Poulet was a journalists & chroniclers from Liège (1893-09-04, Liège–1989-10-06). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
